entries.en: Jannequinard is nigh ready to burst with excitement. Make the viscount wait any longer and there is certain to be a wardrobe malfunction.
entries.fr: Jannequinard est impatient de vous annoncer une grande nouvelle.
entries.ja: 聖ガンリオル占星院のジャンヌキナルは、冒険者の訪問を待ちわびているようだ。

entries.en: Jannequinard believes you are ready to open the gate to the sixth heaven. This, however, is not his decision to make. Speak with Leveva on the second floor of the Athenaeum Astrologicum and find out what she believes.
entries.fr: Jannequinard vous a annoncé que le moment était venu de partir ouvrir la sixième et dernière porte du firmament. Avant cela, Leveva a quelque chose d'important à vous dire. Retrouvez-la à l'étage supérieur.
entries.ja: ついに六つめの天界の門を開くことになった。聖ガンリオル占星院の「レヴェヴァ」と話そう。

entries.en: It turns out Leveva also believes you are ready to open the sixth gate, but before proceeding any further, she instructs you on the concept of synastry and the benefits it may bring your allies in the field.
entries.fr: L'astromancienne tenait à vous apprendre une nouvelle technique avant que vous ne partiez ouvrir la dernière porte. En route pour la voûte de la glace !
entries.ja: レヴェヴァと話して、新たな術の伝授を受けた。身の危険を感じているらしい「レヴェヴァ」に、もう一度声をかけよう。
entries.frMacro: L'astromancienne tenait à vous apprendre une nouvelle technique avant que vous ne partiez ouvrir la dernière porte. En route pour la voûte de la glace<nbsp>!

entries.en: Speak with Leveva on the second floor.

Lady Leveva tells me that you are nearly ready to open the sixth and final gate. Yes. I said final. We all know there are seven heavens, but opening the seventh is impossible...well, except upon death, of course. An attempt to attune to the pole star would be sheer madness and most certainly spell your doom. Ah, but look at me. Even now, attempting to tutor the great , when it is obvious your talent far surpasses mine. Forgive me.

ごきげんよう、さん。
これまでに、五つの天界の門を開いてきましたが、
ついに、残された最後の「六天」の門を開く刻がきました。

entries.en: Lady Leveva has yet to depart for the location of the final gate. Doubtless she fears yet another bandit attack, but whatever the reason, she remains on the second floor and has asked that you visit her at your earliest convenience.
entries.fr: Mais avant cela, il semble qu'elle ait quelque chose de très important à vous dire. Allez la rejoindre à l'étage supérieur.
entries.ja:
修練に出向く前に、レヴェヴァ師が、
貴方に話しておきたいことがあるそうです。
二階にいらっしゃるので、声をかけて差し上げてください。

entries.en: Lady Leveva is on the second floor only because she refuses to accept the room I have offered her at Durendaire Manor. It is not as if I would make any untoward attempts at sullying her honor. Having seen but half the summers as I, she is far too young for my tastes.
entries.fr: Avant de partir ouvrir la sixième porte, il semble que dame Leveva ait quelque chose de très important à vous dire. Allez la rejoindre à l'étage supérieur.

entries.en: You have come far since that fateful day our paths first crossed in the Black Shroud. And now, here we are, on the cusp of your attunement with the sixth heaven. Time truly waits for no , does it?

entries.en: Before we set forth on this task, I wish to teach you of a technique known as “synastry.”
entries.fr: Mais avant cela, je voudrais vous enseigner une technique supplémentaire. Vous savez bien qu'on n'est jamais trop prudent, surtout quand on a un aimant à bandits de tout poil comme moi à ses côtés.
entries.ja:
……これまでの度重なる襲撃を考えると、
いつ何が起こるかわからぬ状況だ。
汝には、あらかじめ可能なかぎりの術を教えておきたい。

entries.en: By temporarily enjoining your fate with that of a companion's, they will reap the stars' benefit as do you.
entries.fr: Cette technique se nomme “Synastrie”. Elle sert à prodiguer des soins à un allié chaque fois que vous lancez un sort de magie curative.
entries.ja:
此度、教えるのは「シナストリー」だ。
ともに戦う者にこれを用いれば、
ほかの仲間に対する癒やしの一部を、分けあたえることができる。

entries.en: As a passable journeyman astrologian, you already wield sufficient control over aether. You need only focus it upon establishing a bond with your chosen ally to achieve synastry.
entries.fr: Servez-vous en pour changer un destin funeste en un destin plus clément !
entries.ja: この術を駆使し、仲間たちの運命も切り開くが良い！
